name: SubFlow
caption: When invoked as a SubFlow

configuration.description: Input parameters: [{ "name": "<identifier>", "type": "Value"|"Reference", "tableNo": <integer, Reference only>, "required": <boolean> }]. name: letters, digits and underscore only, unique; becomes the trigger output name (truncated to 30). type defaults to 'Value'. tableNo narrows a Reference parameter to one table (0 = any table). Rows with an empty name are dropped by the editor. An empty array is valid.
Written only when the SubFlow is saved as a template / exported: the flow's Code. On import it is restored to the flow card if no other flow already uses that Code.
Written only on template save / export: the flow's custom icon URL. Restored on import only if it starts with https://.

outputs.name: <inputs[].name>
outputs.when: one per inputs entry; type 'reference' with tableNo = inputs[].tableNo (0 = untyped) when inputs[].type = 'Reference', otherwise 'value'

rules.check: configuration.inputs, if present, must be an array of objects.
Every inputs[].name must be non-empty and contain only A-Z, a-z, 0-9 and '_' (regex ^[A-Za-z0-9_]+$).
inputs[].name values must be unique (case-sensitive comparison).
inputs[].type should be 'Value' or 'Reference'. Anything other than 'Reference' is treated as a value parameter.
The flow header must have a Code (not part of the definition JSON). Run SubFlow steps and templates reference SubFlows by Code.
rules.message: A Code must be set on the Flow Card before this SubFlow can be published. Run-SubFlow steps and templates reference SubFlows by Code, not by No.

rules.check: A SubFlow execution cannot be driven by a Job Queue entry on its own.
rules.message: Execution %1 belongs to a SubFlow. SubFlows run only as part of the flow that calls them and cannot be started directly.

notes: Runs synchronously inside the calling flow's Run SubFlow step, as part of the caller's run (same session, same transaction frame). Its steps are logged under the calling step. A SubFlow never starts on its own and has no Job Queue entry.
SubFlows do not count against the licensed-flow limit; publishing skips the licensing registration.
Publishing marks the flow as a SubFlow. No trigger registration is written; callers find the SubFlow by its Code.
Return values are set with the Return SubFlow Output step, which is ONLY offered in SubFlow flows.

Use a trigger that runs in the background, such as a record trigger, a schedule or a manual start.'). Steps that yield (Respond to Webhook, Return PDF, Set report file name) fail at run time inside a SubFlow.
Picker filters: Respond to Webhook, Return PDF, Set report file name, Set document field values and Prevent page close are hidden.
The 'required' flag is informational for the Run SubFlow step's input binding; the trigger itself does not enforce it.
Reference parameters are passed by the caller as a record selector; Value parameters as text.
